verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own marketing docs say admins can customize roles and permissions for team members and manage user and employee permissions, so the core capability exists. The docs never show how granular these roles are, or that permissions can be scoped by location or department. The only departmental mention is budget controls, which is a related feature rather than permission scoping. Missing for 10: documented granular role definitions, location-scoped permissions, department-scoped permissions, in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments
